# Goodness of Fit

![Goodness of Fit function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/fitting/15-goodness_of_fit.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Measures supplied predictions without refitting. SSE=sum(abs(w)*r^2); SST uses the unweighted Y mean; R-square=1-SSE/SST, possibly negative. RMSE=sqrt(SSE/DOF), default nonpositive DOF replaced by n-2. Constant observations require a diagnostic. Variants: default.

<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**Goodness of Fit**

Mesure SSE, R² et RMSE à partir des prédictions fournies, sans réajuster les paramètres. Variantes : default.

</details>
